name: tg-pane
description: Telegram in a Claude Code pane: private chats with replies, categories (all chats and folders), model summaries of unread posts

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python that has Playwright installed (pip install playwright; python -m playwright install chromium).

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Where the Telegram Web browser profile (your session — keep it private), the counters cache and the lock live. Empty: ~/.local/share/tg-pane.

privateFolder.title: Private chats folder
privateFolder.description: A Telegram folder for the «Private» tab. Empty: every chat with a person or a bot.

language.title: Language
language.description: The pane's language and the language of summaries.

autoReadChannels.title: Mark channels read on open
autoReadChannels.description: Opening a channel on the «Channels» tab marks it read, as Telegram does. Private chats and groups are never marked read by just looking.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA name for message times, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty: the system's; on a server set to UTC the pane asks once.
